title: Fast Path: Internal Mobility Spotlight & 14-day Exchange
body:
Purpose:
Short: create a light-weight, repeatable ‘fast path’ for internal candidates to trial a new role via a 14-day exchange and an accelerated interview + scorecard loop.

Background / why this exists:
- Internal mobility requests often stall because hiring managers want a lot of evidence and candidates don’t want to leave their current pod for long.
- We piloted 30-day shadow exchanges last year; higher acceptance but long to run. Ops cost high.
- A 14-day cap gives enough exposure for most role families (product, platform, solutions) while reducing churn.

Goals (success metrics):
- Time-to-decision (internal candidate) <= 21 days from application to decision.
- 80% of exchanges complete without negative impact on originating team (tracked with manager signoff).
- Candidate ramp confidence >= 4/5 on self-assessment at day 14 for >70% of pilots.
- Conversion rate to role (perm or formal transfer) >= 50% for candidates who passed rubric.

Scope / eligible roles:
- Primarily IC roles up to Senior level (L5-L6) across eng, product, solutions.
- Excludes roles requiring long certification (security compliance-only jobs, paid external certifications).
- Owner discretion: hiring manager + originating manager both need to sign off.

Candidate profile for fast-path:
- Current Redwood tenure >= 6 months (soft).
- Demonstrated cross-functional work or project overlap with target team.
- Manager OK for 14-day partial release (up to 40% time).

Selection & interview loop (accelerated):
1) Short intake (asynchronous) – candidate fills intake form (skill mapping, motivation, top projects) — goal: 48 hours.
2) Hiring manager screen (30m) – focus on motivation + overlap.
3) Evidence review (work samples, PRs, doc links) — asynchronous by hiring lead.
4) Exchange approval & schedule — originating manager and hiring manager sign-off (1 business day).
5) 14-day exchange starts. Mid-exchange check-in (day 7) with hiring manager + buddy.
6) Final evaluation (day 14) — scorecard & recommendation (yes/maybe/no).

Interview / evaluation rubric (single-page scorecard to be used across fast-path):
- Technical competence (40%) — evidence from PRs, take-home microtask if needed, day-to-day pairing observation. Score 1-5.
- Role fit / ownership (20%) — ability to drive outcomes in role context. 1-5.
- Collaboration & communication (15%) — cross-team work, doc clarity, stakeholder empathy. 1-5.
- Learning velocity (15%) — picks up domain quickly in exchange pairing. 1-5.
- Manager recommendation (10%) — hiring manager qualitative. 1-5.
Scoring guidance: 4+ on technical + 3+ on most other buckets -> strong pass.

Interviewer guidance (quick bullets for managers/interviewers):
- Keep feedback concrete: cite specific PRs, pairing sessions, docs.
- Use day-7 check-in to course-correct: if candidate is missing a core skill, record a mitigation plan (training + shadow tasks).
- Asynchronous reviewers must leave at least 2 evidence sentences to justify numeric scores.
- Final panel should be lightweight (no full interviews) — 20m alignment meeting if needed.

14-day exchange checklist (operational, to be completed by hiring manager + buddy):
Pre-exchange (Day -3 to 0):
- Confirm time commitments with originating manager (calendar blocks).
- Provision dev access & docs (security signoff if needed).
- Assign buddy and 1st-week pairing schedule.
- Outline 3 concrete objectives for the exchange (deliverables or signals).

Day 1-2: orientation + shadowing
- 2h onboarding with team (context, codebase tour, meetings to attend).
- Buddy pairing: follow a primary owner on day tasks.
- Quick micro-task assigned (small bug or doc update).

Day 3-7: active pairing + micro-deliverable
- Candidate spends ~50% pairing, 50% work on micro-deliverable.
- Mid-week 1: 30m check-in (hiring mgr + buddy) — capture observations.
- Candidate writes 1-page postmortem / learnings at day 7.

Day 8-13: deeper ownership slice
- Increase autonomy on a scoped piece.
- Cross-functional sync scheduled with product/infra as applicable.
- End of week: manager drafts interim recommendation (pass/maybe/fail).

Day 14: wrap & decision
- Final 60m demo + discussion: candidate presents micro-deliverable and 3 learnings.
- Hiring manager completes scorecard and submits recommendation.
- Originating manager does retrospective re: impact.

Buddy pairing schedule (example):
- Week 1 buddy: +1 (day-to-day), shadowing heavy.
- Week 2 buddy: rotate to primary on-call or product partner for broader exposure.
- Expectation: buddy writes 3 short feedback bullets at day 7 and day 14.

Onboarding admin checklist (ops items):
- Access: repo, CI, staging, slack channels.
- Shortcuts: code search, debug notes, local dev env script.
- Safety: PR/merge guidance, testing expectations.
- Meetings: required standups, key stakeholder weekly.

Decision matrix & next steps after day 14:
- PASS: offer to transfer or formal role; HR to issue change-of-role paper within 7 days.
- MAYBE: extend trial (one additional 7-day focused scope) OR step back to conventional interview (manager decides).
- FAIL: origin manager consulted; candidate returned with documented feedback + L&D recommendations.

Operational responsibilities (short):
- People Ops: maintain template intake form, track metrics, escrow spot in calendar pool for fast-path.
- Hiring Manager: define 3 objectives, assign buddy, complete scorecard.
- Originating Manager: approve time allocation and capture backlog/impact mitigation plan.

Measurement & follow-up (post-exchange):
- Day 30 check-in for transferred candidates: self-assessment + manager assessment.
- Metric dashboard: time-to-decision, conversion rate, originating-manager-impact (survey).

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Should we allow external hires to do a 14-day paid trial? (legal + comp implications) -> talk to legal.
- What fraction of roles need a small take-home microtask pre-exchange? Define guardrails.
- Need templates for intake + scorecard in Confluence (owner: Jordan).
- Build a short Slack workflow to capture day-7 feedback easily.

Communications plan (for pilot cohort):
- People Ops announcement + one-pager with eligibility and intake link.
- Manager training drop (15m) on how to run exchange.
- Pilot run: 10 candidates across eng/product in Q1; survey both managers and candidates.

Appendix (examples / canned language):
- Sample exchange objective: "Own a single Jira ticket from spec->PR and validate end-to-end in staging with stakeholder sign-off."
- Sample intake prompt: "List 3 past projects that map to this role’s responsibilities. Which of the role’s top 5 skills do you expect to ramp in 14 days?"

Notes: informal, changing. Lean drafts OK — final playbook will be added to Confluence when pilot complete.

Next steps (immediate):
- Jordan: build intake + scorecard templates (due 2026-02-21).
- Aisha: coordinate manager training (slot w/eng leads) by 2026-02-28.
- Marcus: set up pilot metrics dashboard (PEO-789) by 2026-03-07.
